'''Alfred Dong Who Let The Dogs Out?''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Alfred Dong]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds130.htm Who Let The Dogs Out?], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041027092248/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds130.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alfred Dong]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
